title: Oil prices move higher as recovering Hormuz Strait traffic tempers war premium
summary_full: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said in a note on Friday that stronger oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz had eased market concerns after U.S.-Iran strikes earlier this week.
